notes.title: Patch Notes 20/3-2017
notes.content:
Thanks for the people who left feedback for us! We are really grateful! Here are some of the fixes we have made.

Quality of life improvements
[list]
    [*]You can now go back to the menu by holding the menu button, also if you simply press the button down fast you can reset the level for getting better score.
    [*]Removed extra balls that didn't do anything on some maps
    [*]Changed most of all pink areas into the standard wall color to decrease confusion
    [*]Added so you can see what level you are on after you have completed it
    [*]Changed the color of some goals to match the rest to decrease confusion
    
[/list]

Bug fixes

[list]
    [*]Some of the multiple goal maps have been updated and the bug should be fixed, hard to replicate, so please tell us if it still happens to you.
    [*]Improved the big flat pancake ball problem that can happen on two of the maps
[/list]

Know bugs

Vive controller turns white after using menu button.
